objective: Acquire and scan only the four project-owner-approved Java and Ruby augmentation sources, then determine outcome-blind whether their aggregate supported-cell groups clear the frozen four-family packet-capacity prerequisite.

requirements: Verify every frozen input, instrument, selected identity, exact commit, store, main-branch identity, empty index, runtime path, and initially absent output before writing, scanning, or network access.
Create the isolated artifact directory and copy the mechanism mapping and qualified Java scratch rule byte-for-byte before any Semgrep-capable process.
Perform one exact import-only Semgrep 1.170.0 check, seed a fresh local version cache, and bind SEMGREP_LOG_FILE and SEMGREP_VERSION_CACHE_PATH on every Semgrep-capable process.

Run separated positive and clean offline canaries for the qualified Java SSRF rule and pinned-default Ruby unsafe-deserialization cell. Stop on any failure; do not contact semgrep.dev, use registry resolution, install, downgrade, fall back, tune, or retry.

acquisition_and_scanner_contract.sequence: Only after all preflights and four canary processes pass, shallow-fetch the four subjects from github.com strictly in frozen order and stop before the next subject on any failed boundary.
acquisition_and_scanner_contract.acquisition: Fetch only each exact commit into its stable-identity directory; verify detached HEAD and object identity; do not expand history, submodules, Git LFS, dependencies, archives, generated assets, or execute repository code.
acquisition_and_scanner_contract.snapshot_and_retrieval: Create deterministic normalized snapshot and detector-input digests and one in-memory RetrievalIndex digest per subject. Persist only aggregate index statistics and digests outside the retained snapshot directories; do not expose retrieval results.
acquisition_and_scanner_contract.source_scans: Run exactly one no-retry qualified scratch Java CWE-918 scan over each Java snapshot and exactly one no-retry pinned-default Semgrep scan over each Ruby snapshot. Retain raw SARIF and target reports only beneath the isolated artifact directory.
acquisition_and_scanner_contract.scanner_health: Complete or valid empty output is acceptable. Unavailable, failed, partial, malformed, missing exact runtime/configuration/target provenance, or incomplete output stops the wave.
acquisition_and_scanner_contract.production_rules: The scratch Java rule remains unpromoted and the production supplemental ruleset must remain byte-identical.

aggregate_capacity_contract.mechanism_rule: A new result is compatible only when canonical rule metadata contains exactly the frozen language-cell CWE mechanism: Java CWE-918 or Ruby CWE-502. Result text, rule names, severity, confidence, source, and expected performance cannot establish membership.
aggregate_capacity_contract.deduplication: Use stable inclusive-transitive overlap grouping within exact subject, canonical relative path, and mechanism. Do not use SARIF fingerprints.
aggregate_capacity_contract.capacity_rule: Add only the new Java and Ruby compatible-result and deduplicated-group counts to the frozen base; require every Python, TypeScript, Java, and Ruby family to contribute and sum(min(family_groups,20)) to be at least 40.
aggregate_capacity_contract.passing_route: Record aggregate capacity feasibility and route only to a separately authorized architecture-map and candidate-specific verifier-eligibility gate for the new subjects; do not construct a packet.
aggregate_capacity_contract.failing_route: Record bounded Java and/or Ruby source scarcity and return OPT-010 to prerequisite design without source substitution or further acquisition.
aggregate_capacity_contract.outcome_blinding: Do not read or use security advisories, issues, pull requests, exploit reports, vulnerability databases, human responses, assessments, labels, outcomes, known-vulnerable identities, scores, ranks, predictions, or expected performance.

sequence: Verify immutable bindings, approval, workspace, store, runtime, and output absence.
Create isolated runtime state and freeze copied mapping and scratch rule.
Run one import check and four separated offline cell canary scans.
Acquire, snapshot, index, and scan only the four exact subjects in order.
Persist one aggregate capacity artifact and result, verify all boundaries, and stop.

stop_conditions: Any frozen input, instrument, source identity, exact commit, store, branch, index, runtime path, copied configuration, or initially absent output drifts.

Any preflight or canary fails; a scanner process lacks either runtime binding; semgrep.dev, registry rules, an unlisted tool or host, a retry, fallback, installation, downgrade, or rule change is attempted.

Any unlisted source, unsupported language, source substitution, provider, credential, production store, outcome source, repository code, dependency resolver or installer, human review, assessment, label, training, rescoring, git mutation, or lifecycle activity occurs.

Any normalized candidate or issue-group identity, subject-level finding count, path, rule beyond the frozen rule identities, symbol, excerpt, score, rank, prediction, expected outcome, or partial packet is persisted or disclosed, or any ceiling is reached.
excluded: any other source, remaining primary or reserve activation, source substitution, production-rule editing or promotion, scratch-rule tuning, additional Java clients or Ruby mechanisms, new scanner rules, scanner retry, architecture recovery, provider or Keychain use, agentic or baseline execution

normalized candidate, issue-group, or packet persistence or disclosure; subject-level finding counts; source rendering; human finding review; outcomes; assessments; labels; precision; recall; G03b or G04 decisions

packet construction, threshold selection, training, rescoring, tuning, recalibration, production-policy changes, OPT-010 promotion or closure, OPT-014 or SEC/EDGAR reactivation, OPT-036 use or change, integration, push, and deployment
